summary: iteration_14: tested library rename/edit feature end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (PUT /api/bible/library/{id}: 404 unknown/bad id, same-name allowed with prepared_updated=0, 409 case-insensitive duplicate excluding self, propagation to linked prepared only (unlinked untouched, all mutable fields including title_or_note=name updated), alphabetical GET /library, auth required). Frontend: PIN unlock -> seed via REST with ss_session_bible bearer token -> reload. Edit dialog opens with title 'Edit library slide', library-name-input prefilled with current name, prepared-reference-input / prepared-text-input / prepared-reference-only-checkbox / prepared-kind-scripture|custom / prepared-save-btn all present. Rename zeta -> bravo re-sorts the list alphabetically without reload. Editing the alpha library item (which was linked to a prepared item on 2099-01-04) immediately updates the prepared card: title_or_note becomes 'TEST alpha RENAMED', reference becomes 'John 3:16' - no manual reload required. Duplicate name attempt ('test mike slide' when another exists) keeps dialog open and shows toast "A library slide named 'test mike slide' already exists." Regression confirmed: prepared Add dialog has no library-name-input and title is 'Add prepared item'. All TEST data cleaned up; user's real 'Genesis 1:1' prepared item on 10/11/2026 and appearance assets untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: library_routes.update_library_item: clean implementation. Uses _ci + $ne self for duplicate check, update_many on bible_prepared filtered by library_id, returns prepared_updated count. All fields except name propagate (correct per spec).

SlideLibrary.saveEdit signature destructures service_date/title_or_note/library_id out of the PreparedDialog payload before PUT /bible/library/{id} - matches LibraryIn schema exactly. Toast message correctly pluralizes 'prepared item(s)'.
SlideLibrary.addToService now includes library_id when posting to /bible/prepared - enabling future edits to propagate.

PreparedDialog: `withName = item.name !== undefined` cleanly branches on whether the dialog is for a library item vs a prepared item. Name field only renders when needed. Submit prop allows injection of library-save flow without duplicating the dialog JSX. Good reuse.

Minor: PreparedDialog `save` sends full form including service_date/library_id to the library submit handler; SlideLibrary destructures them out — harmless but slightly leaky. Could trim at source. Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows exercised: rename+resort, edit propagation to linked prepared without reload, 409 duplicate toast, add-prepared regression no name field)

test_credentials: PIN 1234 (bible); session token stored in localStorage.ss_session_bible as Bearer JWT
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted on 2099-01-04: library items 'TEST zeta/alpha/mike slide' + renames; prepared item linked to alpha. All cleaned up at end. User's real 'Genesis 1:1' prepared on today's date (10/11/2026) and appearance images/logo/church_name untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test at /app/backend/tests/test_iter14_library_rename.py is self-cleaning and safe to re-run (uses TEST_ prefix and far-future date 2099-01-04). To hit authenticated API from browser DevTools or page.evaluate: tok = localStorage.getItem('ss_session_bible'); fetch with 'Authorization: Bearer '+tok (NOT credentials:'include' - the app does not use cookies). SlideLibrary load() is triggered via `tick` prop or on mount; backend-only inserts require a page.reload() to appear. PreparedDialog is reused for library edits via `item.name !== undefined` branch + `submit` prop override. Service date input accepts fill('2099-01-04').
